question: Should this prematurely opened RFC remain upstream as the active design venue despite the contributor’s stated request to withdraw it?
rationale: The proposal defines a broad new core configuration contract, and choosing to retain and develop it upstream requires explicit repository-owner sponsorship rather than an automated cleanup judgment.

options.title: Close Until Ready
options.body: Honor the contributor’s request and invite reopening or a fresh upstream RFC after the fork draft, metadata, and discussion context are ready.

options.title: Sponsor Upstream Drafting
options.body: Keep this PR open and explicitly adopt it as the active design venue while maintainers resolve the remaining configuration-contract decisions.

recommendation.title: Close Until Ready
recommendation.body: Honor the contributor’s request and invite reopening or a fresh upstream RFC after the fork draft, metadata, and discussion context are ready.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the current RFC lifecycle that governs whether an acknowledged premature draft should remain open for upstream development.
